verdict.rationale: Mistral is an API-first model platform, so headless use is its core mode. The docs cover programmatic API requests, official Python and TypeScript SDKs installable via pip, asynchronous batch inference for large workloads, and an Agents API for autonomous task execution, all of which fit unattended scripts and pipelines. A community user also reports programmatic JSON generation through the API. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions examples or non-interactive auth setup), an official CLI for scripted use, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
